△ Caution: To customers — Please read carefully.
● This product is intended for Ages 15+. Do not give it to children younger than the specified age. ● Be sure to read the WEB Instruction Manual. ● This product contains small parts. Take care to prevent small children from accidentally swallowing them, as there is a risk of choking. ● There are pointed and sharp parts; handle and store with care to avoid unexpected injury. ● Do not use near your ears; improper use may damage hearing. ● This product contains electronic components; users with pacemakers should exercise caution. Be careful not to get fingers, hair, or clothing caught in rotating parts. ● Do not put fingers or other objects into gaps of moving parts, as they may become caught and cause injury. ● Do not stare at flashing LED lights for long periods; this may cause discomfort.
《Improper battery use may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following:》
● Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries. Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. ● Insert batteries with the + (plus) and - (minus) terminals correctly. ● After use, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage. Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire. ● If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it gets on skin or clothing, wash with water. ● When disposing of batteries or the product, follow your local municipality's waste disposal instructions.

blocks.text: 通称は、守護神の名に由来し･･･。 王様戦隊キングオージャーとする。
blocks.translation: Its common name is derived from that of the guardian deity... and is designated as Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger.

blocks.text: 降臨せよ!エクストリームキングオージャー!
俺は媚びねぇ、へつらわねぇ。誰が相手になろうとも、意地とドタマでブッチギる。
blocks.translation: I don't pander, and I don't grovel. No matter who stands in my way, I'll leave them in the dust—driven by sheer grit and my own headstrong will.

blocks.text: それが、ンコンパ総長、ヤンマ・ガストだ。
blocks.translation: That is Nkompa President Yamma Gast.

blocks.text: 我が名はイシャバーナの女王ヒメノ・ラン。
blocks.translation: My name is Himeno Ran, Queen of Ishabana.

blocks.text: ただ我がままに我が道をゆく!散ることを知らぬ花･･･。 その気高きを知るがよい!
blocks.translation: I walk my own path, true only to myself! A flower that knows not how to wither... Behold its noble majesty!

blocks.text: 民とは命なり。民のためには、 泥に塗れて手を汚す。
blocks.translation: The people are life itself. For their sake, I will soil my hands and be covered in mud.

blocks.text: それが豊穣の大殿様 カグラギ・ディボウスキ。
blocks.translation: That is the Great Lord of Abundance, Kaguragi Dybowski.

blocks.text: 法とは王を穿つ矛。 法とは民を守る盾。 なればこそ、ゴッカンは不動なり。
blocks.translation: The law is a spear that pierces the king. The law is a shield that protects the people. That is precisely why Gokkan stands immovable.

blocks.text: 地が裂け天が降ろうともこのリタ・カニスカは揺るがない!
blocks.translation: Even if the earth splits and the heavens fall, I, Rita Kaniska, shall not waver!

blocks.text: 俺は、ジェラミー・イドモナラク・ネ・ブラシエリ。
blocks.translation: I am Jeramie Idmonarak ne Brasieri.

blocks.text: 人、バグナラク、全てを統べて、世界の運命を定める狭間の王様、
blocks.translation: The King of the In-Between who rules over all—humans and Bugnarak alike—and determines the fate of the world,

blocks.text: その有様を、永久に語り継ぐといい!
blocks.translation: See to it that the tale of that spectacle is passed down forever!

blocks.text: 恐怖しろ! そしておののけ! 一切の情け容赦なく一木一草ことごとく!
blocks.translation: Tremble in fear! Quake! Without a shred of mercy—leaving not a single tree or blade of grass standing!

blocks.text: 貴様を討ち滅ぼす者の名はギラ・ハスティー! そして
blocks.translation: The name of the one who will destroy you is Gira Husty! And...

blocks.text: 王様戦隊キングオージャー!
俺様たちが世界を支配する!
blocks.translation: We're going to rule the world!
